description: Per-agent rate limits for MCP tool calls through the APIM AI gateway. This file is the single source of truth; it is compiled into an APIM policy by infra/modules/model-gateway/apim-mcp-compliance.bicep (applied during 'azd up' and re-applied on demand by the deploy-compliancy workflow). Each agent is keyed by the AppId carried in its AgenticIdentityToken. DENY-BY-DEFAULT: any AppId not listed here is rejected with HTTP 403.
